description: Two sections, each one a large offset knob and four attenuverted inputs summed into a single output, for blending modulation signals, mixing audio or putting out a constant voltage

params.text: Sets the offset added to the sum of that section: 0-10V in UNI, -5V to +5V in BIP, and in MIX it works as a master level over the summed signals instead
Attenuates and inverts the input of the same number in that section
Picks what the large knob of that section does: UNI a unipolar offset of 0-10V, BIP a bipolar offset of -5V to +5V, MIX a master level over the sum of the inputs

inputs.text: A signal for that section, scaled by the attenuverter of the same number

outputs.text: The four inputs of that section at their attenuverter settings, summed with the offset from the large knob
